notes.title: Official Publisher Announcement
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings Pilot  [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29467184/45faf5f884b5c127167fabc9f546c57022f165d1.png[/img]

[h2]We are proud to announce that Burst Fighter is now in publishing partnership with indie.io ![/h2]

We start 2025 with one of the biggest moves we ever do for Burst Fighter, we  chose to  collaborate together with the indie.io team as our new publisher partner. After some thorough discussion, we believe in their team capabilities , especially because they have a great track record with helping other indie games reach more players.

Many of you may be asking a question, why do we take this sudden decision ? 

Since the first release, we have always struggled with delivering Burst Fighter to many players, we are a team of passionate developers that are always confident of a great gaming experience, but the lack of marketing proficiency hinders us from maximizing the game's potential. 

Working with a game publishing platform like indie.io greatly helps us as indie developers to focus on game development while they handle all the behind-the-scenes magic. From helping improve our store pages to crafting marketing campaigns and even helping the game shine at both digital and live events, indie.io helps in all the aspects that we struggle hard

[h2]Thank you for continuing to support us until today ! [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29467184/c803dfc7532cb57a75b5d781d32aa3cd9cd20473.png[/img]

We couldn’t have gotten to this point without all of you. We can’t wait to show you our new plan for 2025 , Burst Fighter was never this strong in the past and we believe that by the support from indie.io team we're gonna deliver the best experience to you  . Don’t forget to wishlist the game and join our Discord community to be notified of future announcements!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29467184/9a0470f84182983341515b37ad1670ced52d7797.png[/img]

notes.title: Burst Fighter Return !
notes.content:
[h1][b]BIG ANNOUNCEMENT !![/b][/h1]

Hi everyone, it's been a super long time. We know that it's been one of our regret that we cannot give burst fighter a proper support because of the studio condition..

But now we are back , thinking about you the players of how we want to go forward with new friends in studio and new name ! Our team is currently preparing some quality of life improvement for burst fighter , while it doesn't exactly mean there will be a big update, but there is some exciting thing happen, the detailed list is:

[b]- UI/UX improvement
- NEW boss rush mode !
- New animation improvement 
- Post processing filter option - giving you many option to customize game look with the filter [/b]

Of course there is a plan to improve it further in the future, but currently we focus on fix things that we realize actually improve overall experience first.

We choose to announce this today, because it also to celebrate our studio first ever experience to attend Tokyo Game Show !! we will open our own booth at Hall 9 Makuhari Messe with the booth number is E 123, if you ever have a time feel free to visit us there and have a talk with us

And for note, maybe some of you realize that there is change in the pricing. Actually we just return the game price to how it is originally, because of how steam evolved since our release back in 2017 there is some adjustment needed regarding the pricing policy, we really sorry for this inconvenience, but we will make sure that we gonna give you event better support in the near future

Once again, thank you for everyone who love playing our games, keep giving us proper support in our darkest day. Now we are ready to take off once more and blasting through the space !!
